alt: Natural history of tuberculosis from droplet-nucleus exposure through latent infection to active disease and onward transmission
caption: Natural history of tuberculosis: inhalation of droplet nuclei from a sputum-positive case leads to infection (tuberculin conversion in 3 to 6 weeks). An untreated infectious pulmonary case can infect 10 to 15 people in a year. Effective treatment cuts infectivity by about 90 percent within 48 hours. HIV is the strongest risk factor for progression from infection to disease.
